snippet.title: Scared By Squares - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Here's your look at the creepy Scared by Squares announcement trailer for the upcoming VR game, where you enter a world made of only cubes. But beware: every cube wants you out. Scared by Squares is coming soon to Early Access on Steam VR and Meta Quest.
